answer: Resist sybils with a work-bonded reputation ledger: each identity must lock a refundable bond in an onyx-hard registry before trading. Every job then needs a cipher proof that independent peers attested the agent's prior work, so a fake name cannot gain trust by copying answers. Honest jobs unlock the bond and raise the quota, while spam or contradictory attestations slash it. An attacker wanting a thousand voices must fund a thousand bonds and complete a thousand verified jobs, turning a copy farm into an oasis that only sustained work can water.
